target.class_name: Anh văn chuyên ngành Cơ khí

questions.question: Any activity such as tests, adjustments, lubrication and repairs that keeps a unit able to do its job.
questions.explanation: tests, adjustments, lubrication, repairs → maintenance (bảo dưỡng).

questions.question: A part that supports a rotating shaft and reduces friction.
questions.explanation: supports a rotating shaft → bearing (ổ bi, ổ trục).

questions.question: The situation in which a machine stops working as it should.
questions.explanation: stops working → failure (sự hỏng).

questions.question: The action of fixing something that is broken or damaged.
questions.explanation: fixing … broken → repair (sửa chữa).

questions.question: Slow damage to a surface because two parts rub together.
questions.explanation: rub together → wear (mòn). Corrosion là gỉ do hoá chất.

questions.question: A flat sheet of soft material fitted between two joined surfaces to make the joint tight.
questions.explanation: between two joined surfaces → gasket (gioăng đệm).

questions.question: A device that removes dirt from the oil.
questions.explanation: removes dirt → oil filter (bộ lọc dầu).

questions.question: A ring fitted around a rotating shaft to keep oil inside and dirt out.
questions.explanation: ring around a shaft … keep oil inside → oil seal (phớt chắn dầu).

questions.question: A soft tube that carries oil under pressure.
questions.explanation: tube … oil under pressure → hydraulic hose (ống mềm thuỷ lực).

questions.question: A loop that goes around two wheels to move power from one to the other.
questions.explanation: loop around two wheels → belt (dây đai).

questions.question: A thin line on a surface where the material has begun to split.
questions.explanation: thin line … begun to split → crack (vết nứt). Leak là chỗ chất lỏng chảy ra.

questions.question: Liquid put into an engine to lubricate its moving parts.
questions.explanation: liquid … lubricate → motor oil (dầu nhớt động cơ).

questions.question: Time worked in addition to normal working hours.
questions.explanation: in addition to normal hours → overtime. Downtime là lúc máy ngừng, không phải giờ làm thêm.

questions.question: The stock of goods, such as spare parts, kept in a store.
questions.explanation: stock of goods kept in a store → inventory (hàng tồn kho).

questions.question: The outer cover that protects the parts inside a machine.
questions.explanation: outer cover → casing (vỏ máy).

questions.question: Complete: "Corrective maintenance, also known as ______ maintenance or run-to-failure maintenance."
questions.explanation: Article 1: corrective còn gọi là breakdown maintenance (bảo dưỡng khi máy hỏng).

questions.question: Complete: "Preventive maintenance gives improved ______ of equipment."
questions.explanation: Lợi ích của preventive: improved reliability (độ tin cậy cao hơn).

questions.question: Complete: "Preventive maintenance gives less unplanned ______ caused by equipment failure."
questions.explanation: Máy ngừng ngoài kế hoạch = unplanned downtime; preventive làm giảm nó.

questions.question: Complete: "The fuel line ______, resulting in a major leak."
questions.explanation: Đường dẫn nhiên liệu bị vỡ (ruptured) nên mới rò rỉ lớn.

questions.question: Complete: "When a machine ______, fix it."
questions.explanation: Logic của corrective maintenance: When a machine breaks, fix it.

questions.question: Read Article 1 (corrective maintenance). Mark each statement True or False.

statements.text: Corrective maintenance is also called breakdown maintenance.
High machine downtime is one of the expenses of corrective maintenance.
A plant using run-to-failure management spends money on maintenance before a machine fails.
Corrective maintenance gives high production availability.

questions.explanation: Run-to-failure: không tốn tiền bảo dưỡng cho tới khi máy hỏng; chi phí gồm downtime cao và low production availability.

questions.question: Read Article 2 (preventive maintenance). Mark each statement True or False.

statements.text: Preventive maintenance leads to more unnecessary inspections.
Preventive maintenance helps prolong the life of equipment.
Preventive maintenance causes more expensive repairs after unexpected failures.
Preventive maintenance is routine maintenance of equipment and machinery.

questions.explanation: Preventive đem lại less unnecessary inspections và fewer expensive repairs; prolonged life là một lợi ích.

questions.question: Read Article 3 (Flight 236). Mark each statement True or False.

statements.text: An incorrect hydraulic pipe was fitted to the right-hand engine.
The pipe that was fitted was too small.
The wrong pipe was found before take-off.
Flight 236 was flying from Toronto to Lisbon.

questions.explanation: Ống bị lắp sai và oversized (quá lớn); lỗi went undetected tới đêm 24/8/2001.
